evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: west road of 九洲清晏 after 1828
evidence.date: post 2024, on plans of Jiaqing to Daoguang
evidence.summary: Sequence of works on Yangshi Lei plans: after 1828 清晖阁 became 湛静斋 with 穿堂殿 and 后殿; 1831 怡情书史 and its fish pond gave way to 慎德堂; 1836 the three axis halls were rebuilt and 同道堂 added; 1846 the four courts of 洞天深处 became two. This fits the labels 前殿, ?顺堂, 后殿 on S01 as the former 湛静斋 group.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 后殿.
